_doc: Written by android/scripts/copy_search_rules.py. Do not edit the files in this folder: edit the source in packbuilder/ and run the script again.

abbreviations.json.used_by: search key normaliser: abbreviations, stopwords, state names, street types, connectors

ranking.json.used_by: search engine: every ranking weight and search limit, the house-number join config

us_street_norm.json.used_by: address normaliser and parser: street types, directionals, units, states, ordinals

lookup_config.json.used_by: address lookup: locality, match, accuracy and source scores

search_app.json.used_by: search screen and saved places: near, typing, merge, recents, saved, shortcuts

fingerprint_spellings.json.used_by: fingerprint check at open: the spellings of the street-key fingerprint

poi_icons.json.used_by: search rows and the place sheet: search category id -> sprite icon name
